capabilities: Load JavaScript and TypeScript modules from the vault and the Internet
Run exported startup functions when Obsidian starts
Resolve relative paths, vault paths, wikilinks, Markdown links and external links
Load Markdown files as code via their code blocks
Debug modules with generated source maps
extras: Supports rolling and latest release channels only; includes a security policy with supported-versions table and vulnerability reporting instructions.
problem: Obsidian plugins cannot require JavaScript modules from vault files or remote URLs, so script authors have no built-in way to share and import code.

relations.evidence: Supports popular plugins like Dataview and Templater.
Supports popular plugins like Dataview and Templater.

summary: Module loader that lets you require JavaScript and TypeScript files from the vault or the Internet inside Obsidian.
